health‑related variables and questions on specific diseases/health conditions within the adult population in Germany."},{"title":"ALLBUS 1982 (German General Social Survey 1982)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13389","justification":"Representative survey of adults in Germany in 1982 that includes items on health status and selected diseases/conditions, suitable for studying morbidity patterns in the early 1980s."},{"title":"ALLBUS 1984 (German General Social Survey 1984)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13390","justification":"1984 wave of the German General Social Survey with modules on health and illness, containing variables on specific disorders and self‑reported medical conditions."},{"title":"ALLBUS 1986 (German General Social Survey 1986)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13391","justification":"Mid‑1980s nationally representative dataset for Germany; includes health indicators, chronic diseases and limitations due to illness, useful for trend analyses across the decade."},{"title":"ALLBUS 1988 (German General Social Survey 1988)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13392","justification":"Late‑1980s German survey with questions on health status and illnesses, enabling comparisons of disease prevalence and perceived health over the 1980s."},{"title":"German Socio‑Economic Panel (SOEP), Version 1984–1989 (GESIS Panel Study ZA5900: SOEPcompilation up to 1989)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.5684/soep.v1984-1989","justification":"Longitudinal microdata for West Germany in the 1980s containing repeated health measures, including chronic illnesses and limitations due to specific conditions."},{"title":"West German Population Survey on Health and Illness 1984 (Gesundheit und Krankheit in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland 1984)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.7741","justification":"Dedicated health survey of the West German population in 1984 with detailed questions on specific diseases, chronic conditions, and medical treatment."},{"title":"West German Population Survey on Health and Illness 1988 (Gesundheit und Krankheit in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland 1988)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1714","justification":"Follow‑up to the 1984 health survey, conducted in 1988, focusing on diseases, health complaints, and medical care in West Germany."},{"title":"Health Survey of the Federal Republic of Germany 1984 (Bundesgesundheitssurvey – Pilot 1984)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1444","justification":"Pilot health survey with detailed symptom and diagnosis questions for adults in the Federal Republic of Germany, allowing analysis of specific disorders in the mid‑1980s."},{"title":"Survey on Cancer Awareness and Screening in the Federal Republic of Germany 1987","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1648","justification":"Topical survey focusing on cancer, screening behavior, and knowledge about cancer‑related conditions among adults in West Germany in 1987, centered on a specific disease group."}]}
